import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final double EPS = 1E-15;

    static double mabs(double a) {
        return a < 0 ? -a : a;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int x = sc.nextInt();
        int y = sc.nextInt();
        int n = sc.nextInt();

        int a = 0, b = 1;
        double ans = 1e9;
        double d = (double) x / y;

        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            int l = 0;
            int r = 1000000000;
            while (r - l > 10) {
                int m1 = l + (r - l) / 3;
                int m2 = r - (r - l) / 3;
                double t1 = mabs(d - (double) m1 / j);
                double t2 = mabs(d - (double) m2 / j);
                if (t1 > t2)
                    l = m1;
                else
                    r = m2;
            }
            for (int i = l; i <= r + 3; i++) {
                double v = mabs(d - (double) i / j);
                if (ans - EPS > v) {
                    ans = v;
                    a = i;
                    b = j;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(a + "/" + b);
        sc.close();
    }
}
